# Which roles answer an emphasis and an accent?

Read this when your style plugin answers how loud an emphasis is, how deep an elevation stands or which accent a component takes.

These roles answer three family options: `emphasis` (ghost, primary, secondary, solid), `accent` (gold, muted, plain, primary) and `elevation` (flat, floating). Each name carries the option and the part it paints.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Only Arena's components read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.
